name: Bernini-R (ByteDance) — WAN2.2-T2V-A14B + source-id RoPE + APG
notes: Released June 1 2026 by ByteDance; merged into ComfyUI core PR #14216 on June 9, shipped in v0.25.0 June 16. Same weights as Wan2.2-T2V-A14B; adds source-id RoPE + stream-concat enabling R2V, V2V, RV2V conditioning modes. GGUF Q4/Q5/Q8 or blockswap bring full 14B into 16 GB. Apache 2.0. Drop-in conditioning branch augmenting build_wan22_t2v.

name: SCAIL-2 (Z.ai) — End-to-end character animation on WAN 2.1
notes: CVPR 2026 paper. 14B model on WAN 2.1 (Wan VAE + T5). Driving video + reference character image → animated output, no skeleton/openpose intermediary. In ComfyUI core June 16. Full fp16 ~47 GB peak; GGUF Q-variants (realrebelai/SCAIL-2_GGUF) feasible on 16 GB. Apache 2.0. Needs new builder or significant extension of build_wan_animate_video.

name: one-node-flux-2-klein (faceswap mode)
notes: Released June 18-20 2026. Single ComfyUI widget wrapping the entire FLUX.2 Klein pipeline with a dedicated FACESWAP mode. June 19 update adds external model loader + GGUF support; June 20 adds negative LoRA strength. 4B ~8 GB; 9B FP8 ~14-16 GB. Direct upgrade path for build_klein_headswap reducing multi-node workflow to one node.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap LoRA (bfs_head_v1_flux-klein_4b / _9b)
notes: March 8 2026; community mirrors created June 17 confirming heavy ongoing adoption. 396K downloads, 628 likes, MIT. Dominant diffusion-native face/head-swap LoRA for Klein 4B/9B and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. Replaces inswapper ONNX for Klein builders. 4B = 370 MB, 9B = 663 MB. Fits within 16 GB (9B with FP8 or GGUF).

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap LoRA (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 variant)
notes: Same BFS repo includes Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 weights, enabling face-consistency via the Qwen image-edit pipeline. Different modality from FaceID/IP-Adapter but achieves similar identity locking. Requires ComfyUI Qwen nodes. Nunchaku/GGUF variants run on 16 GB.

name: Depth Anything 3 (DA3) — native in ComfyUI v0.25.0
notes: ComfyUI v0.25.0 (June 16 2026) added native DA3 node support. Variants: Small (0.08B), Base (0.12B), Large (0.35B ~8 GB), Giant (1.15B). DA3-Streaming handles long video under 12 GB. Community wrapper adds point-cloud export and multi-view depth. CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). Switch build_depth_map_v3 to native DA3 node after v0.25.0 update.

name: SAM 3.1 — Meta AI (Object Multiplex)
notes: SAM 3.1 released March 27 2026. ComfyUI PR #13408 merged April 23 2026. Adds shared-memory Object Multiplex for joint multi-object video tracking without accuracy loss. ComfyUI-TBG-SAM3, ComfyUI-Easy-Sam3 (yolain), and Code2Collapse v1.30.4 all support it. Update SAM3 checkpoints across build_sam3_segment, build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract.

name: SAM 3.1 — Meta AI (Object Multiplex)
notes: See build_sam3_segment entry. Same checkpoint update applies to build_sam3_mask.

name: SAM 3.1 — Meta AI (Object Multiplex)
notes: See build_sam3_segment entry. Same checkpoint update applies to build_sam3_extract.

name: SeedVR2 v2 — ICLR 2026 final checkpoint (arXiv June 2026 revision)
notes: SeedVR2 accepted ICLR 2026. arXiv:2506.05301v2 is a June 2026 revision. ICLR-final weights differ from earlier preprint. Verify checkpoint path in build_seedv2r and build_seedvr2_video_upscale points to ICLR-final via numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler.

name: SeedVR2 v2 — ICLR 2026 final checkpoint
notes: See build_seedv2r entry. Same checkpoint update applies to build_seedvr2_video_upscale.

name: Image-to-LoRA V2 (i2L-v2) for FLUX.2-klein-base-4B — DiffSynth/Alibaba
notes: arXiv 2606.13809, June 15-17 2026. Hypernetwork predicting FLUX.2-klein-base-4B LoRA weights in a single forward pass from reference images — replaces hours of per-style training. Companion ZImage-i2L-v2 targets Z-Image. Apache 2.0. No ComfyUI node in Manager registry yet; DiffSynth runner needed. Collapses build_style_transfer LoRA training to 1 inference step.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video (LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA, updated June 19 2026)
notes: Updated June 19 2026 (in-window). IC-LoRA for LTX-2.3 performing frame-accurate video head/face swap. bfs_head_swap_v1_ltx2_ic_lora_6000.safetensors. 334 likes, 1.3K downloads. FP8-quantized LTX-2.3 + GGUF UNet needed for 16 GB. New capability not currently in Spellcaster video builders. Suggest new build_bfs_video_faceswap builder.

name: HyperSwap 1c-256 (FaceFusion v3.6.1)
notes: FaceFusion repo commit June 19 2026 (no new release tag; latest v3.6.1 April 2026). HyperSwap 1c-256 is 2× resolution and better fidelity than inswapper. Partially integrated in ComfyUI-ReActor but open bugs (#208 black circle artifacts, #226). Not a clean drop-in for build_faceswap yet. Monitor ReActor for stable release.

name: FlashVSR v1.1 — CVPR 2026 one-step diffusion video SR
notes: CVPR 2026. v1.1 released Nov 15 2025, stable. 1-step diffusion streaming 2x/4x video SR at ~17 FPS on A100. Tiny Long low-VRAM mode fits 16 GB. SageAttention adds ~20-30% speedup. New video-SR capability complementing/replacing build_seedvr2_video_upscale. Consider new build_flashvsr_video builder.

name: RTX Video Super Resolution (comfyui-deno v0.7.51, June 19 2026)
notes: v0.7.51 released June 19 2026 (in-window). Hardware-accelerated 4K video upscale, no diffusion, no VRAM overhead beyond video buffer. NVIDIA RTX 50xx + Windows only. If Spellcaster targets RTX 50xx Windows users, this is faster than SeedVR2. Also adds RTX VSR 2-Pass variant, LTX 2.3 loader, and Bernini Prompt Guide node.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC, SIGGRAPH 2026)
notes: SIGGRAPH 2026. v0.1.10 May 14 2026. Pixel-aligned 3D from single image with PBR textures (diffuse, metallic, roughness, normal). ComfyUI wrappers: dreamrec/ComfyUI-Pixal3D, Saganaki22/Pixal3D-ComfyUI. VRAM MARGINAL: 16 GB minimum with low_vram=true + 512_cascade pipeline type + max_num_tokens=24576. 3-5 min generation. CUDA only. New build_pixal3d builder candidate.

name: TRELLIS.2 (Microsoft, 4B params)
notes: January 2026 release; ComfyUI wrappers active through April 2026. 4B params, PBR mesh from single image. GGUF variant may fit 16 GB (community recommends 24 GB for full quality). Multiple wrappers: visualbruno, JanskNeh GGUF, PozzettiAndrea. Distinct from HunyuanVideo 3D pipeline. Worth benchmarking on 5060 Ti.

name: LiTo (Apple Research, ICLR 2026) — Gaussian Splat with light fields
notes: Apple ICLR 2026, code open-sourced May 2026. Generates 3D Gaussian Splat with realistic lighting + reflections from single image. ComfyUI wrapper: PozzettiAndrea/ComfyUI-LiTo. Output is Gaussian Splat (not mesh). VRAM unknown on 16 GB; no community reports yet. Monitor.

name: MatAnyone 2 (CVPR 2026 Highlight)
notes: CVPR 2026 Highlight. Inference code March 2026. Learned quality evaluator; fine detail matting (hair, fur, semi-transparent). HuggingFace: AEmotionStudio/matanyone2. ComfyUI nodes: comfy-matanyone2 (spiritform), TrentNodes, Code2Collapse. Best for video matting — complement to static build_rembg_birefnet. Fits 16 GB. New build_matanyone2_video builder candidate.

name: Sapiens2 (Meta AI, April 2026) — human-centric normal + segmentation
notes: Meta released Sapiens2 April 24 2026 (1B matting added May 15). Variants 0.4B-5B, trained on 1B human images at 1K res. 45.6% error reduction vs Sapiens1 on normals; 24.3 mIoU gain on body-part segmentation. Human-centric complement to generic build_normal_map. ComfyUI extension last updated May 6 2026. 0.4B/1B fit 16 GB comfortably. New build_sapiens2_normal builder candidate.

name: LTX-Video 2.3 (Lightricks, 22B, March 2026)
notes: LTX-2.3 (22B, March 5 2026) substantially supersedes LTX-0.9.x. Adds motion-track IC-LoRA control, audio support. build_ltx_video likely still targets 0.9.x checkpoint path. GGUF for 16 GB. Apache 2.0. Builder needs checkpoint-path update. IC-LoRA Motion-Track-Control (Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Motion-Track-Control) released March 25 enables trajectory-guided video.

name: NormalCrafter ComfyUI Wrapper — temporally consistent video normals
notes: NormalCrafter (arXiv April 2025) leverages SVD video diffusion for temporally consistent normal maps. ComfyUI wrapper (AIWarper, last updated May 2025). Handles arbitrary-length video. Complement to image-only build_normal_map for video pipelines. Configurable decode chunk size; works on 16 GB with reduced chunk.

name: NVIDIA PixelDiT-1300M-1024px
notes: CVPR 2026 Best Paper Finalist (arXiv 2511.20645). 1.3B pixel-space DiT, no VAE. GenEval 0.74 / DPG-bench 83.5 — below Flux2 today. ComfyUI v0.25.0 native PiD nodes (PR #14103). New architecture, not a drop-in for existing builders. Monitor for quality improvements; candidate for future build_pixeldit_txt2img.

name: RealRestorer (March 2026) — multi-degradation restoration
notes: March 26 2026. Single model handles blur, noise, haze, rain, reflection, moire. ComfyUI: StartHua/Comfyui_RealRestorer. VRAM WARNING: ~34 GB peak at 1024x1024 without tiling — hard budget bust. Monitor for lower-VRAM tiling modes. Additive to SUPIR, not a drop-in at 16 GB currently.

name: FlashVSR v1.1 — CVPR 2026 video SR (also in restore family)
notes: See video_upscale FlashVSR entry. Also surfaced in the restore/style/3D search as a video super-resolution candidate complementary to SUPIR (which is image-only).

name: CodeFormer++ (paper only, no weights)
notes: October 2025 paper with deformable registration + deep metric learning. Outperforms CodeFormer on FID/LPIPS/NIQE. No public weights as of June 20 2026. Monitor sczhou/CodeFormer. When released, drop-in upgrade for build_face_restore.

name: InfiniteYou (ByteDance, ICCV 2025) — identity-preserving with FLUX DiT
notes: Excellent identity consistency via InfuseNet injection into FLUX DiT. VRAM: 43 GB BF16, 24 GB FP8 — hard budget bust at 16 GB. No GGUF or 4-bit path confirmed. Monitor for quantized release before considering integration.

name: Wan 2.7 (Alibaba) — API-released, no confirmed open weights
notes: Wan 2.7 released April 22 2026 on wan.video/ModelScope. 1080p / up to 15s / native audio output. No official open weights on HuggingFace; community GGUF uplifts only. Requires 24 GB+ for full quality. NOT in June 13-20 window. Monitor Wan-AI HuggingFace org for official weights drop.

name: Wan 3.0 (Alibaba) — announced, weights status UNCONFIRMED
notes: Multiple SEO blogs claim Wan 3.0 released June 19 2026 (60B MoE, 14B active, 4K/30s). Wan-Video GitHub org shows NO Wan3 repo; Wan-AI HuggingFace org shows NO Wan3 models. Last GitHub update April 2026. Do NOT build against this — treat as unconfirmed. Watch Wan-Video org.

name: Code2Collapse ComfyUI-CustomNodePacks v1.30.4
notes: v1.30.4 released May 15 2026. 72-node production VFX suite. LUT tools: Adobe .cube 1D/3D with strength blend, sRGB/linear/Rec.709/ACEScg. Segmentation: SAM 2.1/3.1, 7-backend alpha matting (ViTMatte, MatAnyone2, RVM, Cutie, SAM-HQ, BiRefNet). EXR I/O. Temporal anchors. Single dependency potentially consolidating several builders; evaluate as runtime dependency reduction.
